channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-65400 — Apple macOS
item.description: Threat Signal 68. Apple macOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker on the network to authenticate to Screen Sharing without valid credentials.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH
item.description: Threat Signal 68. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2025-61884 — Oracle E-Business Suite
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Oracle E-Business Suite contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the Runtime component of Oracle Configurator. This vulnerability is remotely exploitable without authentication.

item.title: CVE-2024-57727 — SimpleHelp SimpleHelp
item.description: Threat Signal 84. SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

item.title: CVE-2023-28461 — Array Networks AG/vxAG ArrayOS
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Array Networks AG and vxAG ArrayOS contain a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that allows an attacker to read local files and execute code on the SSL VPN gateway.

item.title: CVE-2022-36537 — ZK Framework AuUploader
item.description: Threat Signal 84. ZK Framework AuUploader servlets contain an unspecified vulnerability that could allow an attacker to retrieve the content of a file located in the web context. The ZK Framework is an open-source Java framework. This vulnerability can impact multiple products, including but not limited to ConnectWise R1Soft Server Backup Manager.

item.title: CVE-2023-0669 — Fortra GoAnywhere MFT
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Fortra (formerly, HelpSystems) GoAnywhere MFT contains a pre-authentication remote code execution vulnerability in the License Response Servlet due to deserializing an attacker-controlled object.

item.title: CVE-2022-27925 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains flaw in the mboximport functionality, allowing an authenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability was chained with CVE-2022-37042 which allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-27924 — Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS)
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) allows an attacker to inject memcache commands into a targeted instance which causes an overwrite of arbitrary cached entries.

item.title: CVE-2016-0189 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. The Microsoft JScript nd VBScript engines, as used in Internet Explorer and other products, allow attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2010-0188 — Adobe Reader and Acrobat
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Unspecified vulnerability in Adobe Reader and Acrobat allows attackers to cause a denial of service or possibly execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2018-15982 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player com.adobe.tvsdk.mediacore.metadata Use After Free Vulnerability

item.title: CVE-2018-4878 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Adobe Flash Player contains a use-after-free vulnerability that could allow for code execution.

item.title: CVE-2021-26411 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2019-11539 — Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 84. Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-85706 — GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition
item.description: Threat Signal 83. GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

item.title: CVE-2023-27351 — PaperCut NG/MF
item.description: Threat Signal 83. PaperCut NG/MF contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations via the SecurityRequestFilter class.

item.title: CVE-2025-49706 — Microsoft SharePoint
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft SharePoint contains an improper authentication vulnerability that allows an authorized attacker to perform spoofing over a network. Successfully exploitation could allow an attacker to view sensitive information and make some changes to disclosed information. This vulnerability could be chained with CVE-2025-49704. CVE-2025-53771 is a patch bypass for CVE-2025-49706, and the updates for CVE-2025-53771 include more robust protection than those for CVE-2025-49706.

item.title: CVE-2024-9474 — Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation through the web-based management interface for several PAN products, including firewalls and VPN concentrators.

item.title: CVE-2021-27877 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker unauthorized access to the BE Agent via SHA authentication scheme.

item.title: CVE-2022-41080 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation. This vulnerability is chainable with CVE-2022-41082, which allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2013-2551 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code via a crafted web site that triggers access to a deleted object.

item.title: CVE-2018-8174 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 83. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the way that the VBScript engine handles objects in memory, aka "Windows VBScript Engine Remote Code Execution"

item.title: CVE-2021-31207 — Microsoft Exchange Server
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Exchange Server contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for security feature bypass.

item.title: CVE-2021-1675 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 83. Microsoft Windows Print Spooler contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-102764 — BeyondTrust Remote Support
item.description: Threat Signal 82. BeyondTrust Remote Support contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on the appliance.

item.title: CVE-2026-105134 — Ahsay AhsayCBS
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands via manipulation of the random parameter in the Replication Receiver component’s /rps/api/json/UpdateReceivers.do endpoint. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-105133.

item.title: CVE-2026-104935 — Ivanti Connect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Ivanti Connect Secure contains an authentication bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2026-93616 — Check Point Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

item.title: CVE-2026-20079 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) and Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

item.title: CVE-2025-14847 — MongoDB MongoDB and MongoDB Server
item.description: Threat Signal 76. MongoDB Server contains an improper handling of length parameter inconsistency vulnerability in Zlib compressed protocol headers. This vulnerability may allow a read of uninitialized heap memory by an unauthenticated client.

item.title: CVE-2025-59718 — Fortinet Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchMaster, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain an improper verification of cryptographic signature vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass the FortiCloud SSO login authentication via a crafted SAML message. Please be aware that CVE-2025-59719 pertains to the same problem and is mentioned in the same vendor advisory. Ensure to apply all patches mentioned in the advisory.

item.title: CVE-2025-6218 — RARLAB WinRAR
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RARLAB WinRAR contains a path traversal vulnerability allowing an attacker to execute code in the context of the current user.

item.title: CVE-2025-54253 — Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Forms
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe Experience Manager Forms in JEE contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-4008 — Smartbedded Meteobridge
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Smartbedded Meteobridge contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote unauthenticated attackers to gain arbitrary command execution with elevated privileges (root) on affected devices.

item.title: CVE-2013-3893 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Internet Explorer contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2024-42009 — Roundcube Webmail
item.description: Threat Signal 76. RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to steal and send emails of a victim via a crafted e-mail message that abuses a Desanitization issue in message_body() in program/actions/mail/show.php.

item.title: CVE-2025-4428 — Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM) contains a code injection vulnerability in the API component that allows an authenticated attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code via crafted API requests. This vulnerability results from an insecure implementation of the Hibernate Validator open-source library, as represented by CVE-2025-35036.

item.title: CVE-2024-48248 — NAKIVO Backup and Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 76. NAKIVO Backup and Replication contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability that enables an attacker to read arbitrary files.

item.title: CVE-2016-3714 — ImageMagick ImageMagick
item.description: Threat Signal 76. ImageMagick contains an improper input validation vulnerability that affects the EPHEMERAL, HTTPS, MVG, MSL, TEXT, SHOW, WIN, and PLT coders. This allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via shell metacharacters in a crafted image.

item.title: CVE-2023-36025 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass Windows Defender SmartScreen checks and their associated prompts.

item.title: CVE-2023-27992 — Zyxel Multiple Network-Attached Storage (NAS) Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Multiple Zyxel network-attached storage (NAS) devices contain a pre-authentication command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute commands remotely via a crafted HTTP request.

item.title: CVE-2023-28252 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) driver contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2023-26360 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2022-44698 — Microsoft Defender
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Microsoft Defender SmartScreen contains a security feature bypass vulnerability that could allow an attacker to evade Mark of the Web (MOTW) defenses via a specially crafted malicious file.

item.title: CVE-2010-1428 — Red Hat JBoss
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Unauthenticated access to the JBoss Application Server Web Console (/web-console) is blocked by default. However, it was found that this block was incomplete, and only blocked GET and POST HTTP verbs. A remote attacker could use this flaw to gain access to sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2010-0738 — Red Hat JBoss
item.description: Threat Signal 76. The JMX-Console web application in JBossAs in Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform performs access control only for the GET and POST methods, which allows remote attackers to send requests to this application's GET handler by using a different method.

item.title: CVE-2018-19949 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

item.title: CVE-2016-6366 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) code of Cisco ASA software could allow an attacker to cause a reload of the affected system or to remotely execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-20753 — Kaseya Virtual System/Server Administrator (VSA)
item.description: Threat Signal 76. Kaseya VSA RMM allows unprivileged remote attackers to execute PowerShell payloads on all managed devices.
